seed: A control added to the starter Nav Bar never covers its title: the title is in the row and takes whatever room is left, so where you let go decides which end of the bar the control joins.

steps.note: the bar has landed, 320 x 48 centred on 640,300. Back at the left, Title in the room left over
double clicking the back label steps INSIDE the bar
a Badge let go on the FAR half joins the trailing end. The title should still read Title and should have narrowed, not disappeared
THE TEST: this is the drop that used to bury the word Title. Both controls should sit at the far end and the title should still be readable between the back label and them
let go just past the back label instead, and the control joins the LEADING end: Back, Badge, Title, then the far end
